# xxd

Create and reverse hexadecimal dumps through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/xxd input.bin

moonx cli/xxd -p input.bin > hex.txt

moonx cli/xxd -r -p hex.txt > restored.bin
```

Read files or stdin and write a formatted dump. Reverse mode accepts supported dumps and can reconstruct output offsets.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Backward seeks on stdin are unsupported. Existing output-file identity and mode guarantees are limited; use a new output path when possible.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
